sections.content: Spanish uses the present tense for current communication habits and routines. Frequency expressions such as *normalmente*, a *menudo* and *cada* *día* make habitual meaning clear. Verbs such as *comunicarse*, contactar and enviar can describe how people use different channels.

items.spanish: Normalmente envío mensajes durante el día.
items.english: I normally send messages during the day.

items.spanish: A menudo me comunico con mis compañeros por videollamada.
items.english: I often communicate with my colleagues by video call.

items.spanish: Cada día contacto con mi familia por teléfono.
items.english: Every day I contact my family by phone.

items.spanish: Ahora muchas personas utilizan la pantalla para comunicarse.
items.english: Now many people use screens to communicate.

sections.content: Use the present tense with frequency expressions to describe regular communication habits.
